name: My submission history

input.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(x ORDER BY x.created_at DESC), '[]'::json)::text AS body FROM ( SELECT m.id, u.handle AS owner, g.slug AS game, m.version, m.repo, m.release_tag,        m.weight_class AS class, m.size_bytes, m.status, m.reject_reason, m.created_at FROM models m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.owner_id JOIN games g ON g.id = m.game_id WHERE m.owner_id = ($1)::uuid   AND (($2)::text IS NULL OR g.slug = ($2)::text)) x

description: The body column is cast to text and parsed back by a parse_json task: Orion's db_read goes through sqlx's Any driver, which cannot decode the Postgres json/jsonb type and fails the task outright. Casting keeps response construction in SQL -- see README 'Postgres builds the response JSON' -- at the cost of one extra task.
